item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01700","case1_error":"Includes a Monday count in Tuesday's total and replaces Tuesday's two tile-counting rounds with one.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written sum as 107 instead of 97.","reason":"Case 1 selects counts from the wrong day; case 2 makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01701","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final numbers after correct deposit formulas; those formulas yield $1,110.","case2_error":"Provides an unsupported final $340 after correct deduction formulas, which yield $184.","reason":"Both give incorrect final numbers without showing an erroneous calculation, following correctly stated formulas.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01702","case1_error":"Evaluates 48 − 17 − 10 as 11 instead of 21, propagating the error into profit.","case2_error":"Evaluates 132 + 35 as 144 instead of 167.","reason":"Both incorrectly evaluate a correctly written arithmetic expression.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01703","case1_error":"Sets Roger's current experience equal to his retirement target, ignoring Tom's stated experience relationship.","case2_error":"Divides total coffee by thermoses consumed instead of multiplying by the consumed fraction, 3/18.","reason":"Case 1 conflates a future target with current experience; case 2 uses an incorrect allocation relationship.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01704","case1_error":"Subtracts shared movies only once, although each shared movie appears three times in the total.","case2_error":"States an unsupported final 300 after correct formulas, which yield 200 pages remaining.","reason":"Case 1 writes an incorrect overlap correction; case 2 supplies an incorrect final number without showing a faulty calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
